queries.name: Explore one country
queries.sql:
SELECT c.name AS country, r.code, r.name AS region
FROM countries AS c JOIN regions AS r ON r.iso_country = c.code
WHERE c.code = :country
ORDER BY r.code

queries.name: Continental summary
queries.sql:
SELECT c.continent, COUNT(DISTINCT c.code) AS countries, COUNT(r.code) AS regions
FROM countries AS c LEFT JOIN regions AS r ON r.iso_country = c.code
GROUP BY c.continent
ORDER BY c.continent
